title: Ukrainian Drone Mastermind, Fired by Kyiv, Will Advise Italy’s Defense Chief
summary_full: The appointment of Mykhailo Fedorov, a Ukrainian former defense minister, showed how other militaries are racing to adapt to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.
